payload.summary: A campaign gathers volunteers, money, and urgency before anyone can give the goal the same name.
payload.body: A campaign gathers volunteers, money, and urgency before anyone can give the goal the same name. Mars conjunct Neptune can make conviction feel like enough direction, so people start donating, confronting, publishing, or organizing while roles and measures of success are still fuzzy. The energy is sincere, but sincerity does not decide where the money or work belongs. Someone has to translate the feeling into a job. Name the objective, who owns it, and what a finished result looks like before the response gets any larger.
